aboutSplit.title: Building Brighter Futures Together
aboutSplit.description: We create practical learning opportunities so every child can learn, grow, and lead.

thumbs.alt: Aerial view of a green learning community

image.alt: Children learning together with school supplies

pillars.title: Access to learning
pillars.text: We open learning centers where schools are far away or out of reach.

pillars.title: Quality teaching
pillars.text: We support local teachers with books, supplies, and practical tools.

pillars.title: Community first
pillars.text: Families, volunteers, and local leaders shape every program.

ourVision.title: Cultivating Knowledge, Nurturing Futures
ourVision.description: We envision a world where every child has access to quality education, equal opportunities, and the confidence to achieve their dreams. Through learning, innovation, and community support, we are building a brighter future for generations to come.
ourVision.highlight: Education for All, Opportunity for Everyone
ourVision.imageAlt: Children learning together and building a brighter future

journey.heading: From one classroom to a movement.
journey.intro: Every step began with a child who wanted to learn and a community that wanted to help.

milestones.title: The first classroom
milestones.text: One room and twenty children began learning together.

milestones.title: Teacher training
milestones.text: Local teachers joined our training program so good lessons could reach more villages.

milestones.title: A growing movement
milestones.text: Today, learning centers support more than 1,200 students.
